notes:
I found three places that run preschool swim lessons in Oakville, Ontario. I assumed Ontario because the town was given without a province. Each pick comes from the operator's own page. None of the pages I read published a fall class day, time or price for preschoolers, so I left those out.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons, YMCA of Oakville",
      "name_evidence": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons",
      "age_fit": "3-5 years",
      "age_evidence": "For children between 3 to 5 years old, the YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons program will introduce your baby, toddler, or preschooler to the basics of swimming.",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville",
      "source_url": "https://ymcaofoakville.org/programs/aquatics/swim-lessons/"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool swim lessons (Preschool levels), Town of Oakville Recreation and Culture",
      "name_evidence": "Children who are five years-old do not need to complete all preschool levels before moving to the Swimmer programs.",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville",
      "source_url": "https://www.oakville.ca/parks-recreation-culture/programs-activities/swimming/aquatics-programs/"
    },
    {
      "name": "Junior swim lessons, Goldfish Swim School – Oakville",
      "name_evidence": "Junior (3-4 years)",
      "age_fit": "3-4 years",
      "age_evidence": "Junior (3-4 years)",
      "source_name": "Goldfish Swim School",
      "source_url": "https://goldfishswimschool.com/oakville/"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **YMCA of Oakville:** 
Swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions.
 
Registration is required each session, for members and non-members alike.
 I found no class day, time or price for preschoolers.
- **Town of Oakville:** The town teaches the Lifesaving Society Swim for Life program, and 
its lessons follow that program.
 The page I used doesn't give the preschool age range. Its registration page said 
fall registration is open
. It also said 
winter registration opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 a.m., with programs browsable from November 24.
 Classes and prices are on the town's online booking system, which I couldn't open.
- **Goldfish Swim School – Oakville:** This is a private indoor swim school. 
Its Junior class is for 3–4 year olds.
 I found no schedule or price for it. Its phone number is 
(289) 806-3919.
